items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I had someone in 1985 that put out, I think it’s listed here, that was kind of — Fernando Gelbart. He had some money and he says, I recorded with Frank Colette

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Love those doctors, don’t you?

I had someone in 1985 that put out, I think it’s listed here, that was kind of — Fernando Gelbart. He had some money and he says, I recorded with Frank Colette and he put the London Philharmonic Strings behind it. I didn’t bring the album, so twenty strings behind me and Frank Colette, most all flute. But as I say he had some money, so let’s do this. So I had four arrangers, George Calendrelli and some other people. But I haven’t recorded since then, that was I think in 1985. I forgot where I’m wandering to. But…
Yeah, you’ve got to think in a whole new key now too, right?
